name: model-eval-gate
description: Versioned, eval-backed delegation policy for AI agents—prove what can leave the frontier model, enforce it in runtimes, and detect drift.

scripts.test: tsx test/parity.ts && python3 test/parity.py && npx tsx test/policy_parity.ts && npx tsx test/graders_ori.ts
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm test
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'pre-commit gates installed (bypass: git commit --no-verify)'
